text: City Council has received and forwarded the 2021 Financial Statements and related documents for the years ended December 31, 2021 from the following City of Toronto Corporations and Partnered Corporation to the Audit Committee for information: - Build Toronto - Casa Loma Corporation - Lakeshore Arena Corporation - Toronto Community Housing Corporation - Toronto Hydro Corporation - Toronto Seniors Housing Corporation - Toronto Pan Am Sports Centre - Toronto Port Lands Company
